commands.reason: Protection event at N03; isolate all incident LV paths (N02-N03, N03-N04, N03-N05).

scenario.name: Single fault isolation
scenario.description: A fault at N03 trips its three incident breakers (SW_N02_N03, SW_N03_N04, SW_N03_N05). Both tie lines stay open, so N04, N05 and N06 are left de-energized -- no restoration path is taken. Use this to characterize the isolation transient and the resulting de-energized island, before comparing against the tie-switch-restoration scenario.
